description: This file defines the ModelAction interface for widgets in the OFBiz framework, specifying methods for accepting visitors and executing actions within a given context.

classes.name: ModelAction
classes.description: Interface that represents an action in the widget model, supporting visitor acceptance and execution within a context.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for processing the ModelAction, allowing external operations to be performed.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the action with a provided context map, possibly throwing a GeneralException.
